title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 Note Frontmatter Schema
description: Standardized frontmatter specification for OKF v0.2 knowledge base notes.

type.description: The structural classification of the note.

tags.description: List of categorical tags for taxonomy filtering.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the note: draft -> stable -> deprecated (absent implies stable).

stale_after.description: Absolute YYYY-MM-DD date after which the concept content requires re-verification.

aliases.description: Alternate titles or synonyms for cross-referencing.

milestone.description: Roadmap milestone identifier (e.g. M1, M2, A1).

feature_status.description: Feature execution status for roadmap tracking.

dependencies.description: Prerequisite milestone identifiers required before this feature can be started.
